mcp_tools.name: auth_design_review
mcp_tools.title: Auth design review
mcp_tools.description: Submits an authentication and authorization design evidence manifest (human auth, sessions, OAuth, service tokens, authorization, lifecycle, anti-abuse, audit) and returns a deterministic AUTH_DESIGN_SOUND / AUTH_DESIGN_DEFICIENT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including password checks gated on passwords being used and OAuth checks gated on OAuth being used, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The auth-design evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

expect.notes: All boolean flags set to pass the skill quality gates and red lines.

method 1: MFA is enforced for sensitive operations

method 7: anomalies alert — new geography, spikes
method 8: authentication events — success and failure — are logged
method 8: authorization denials are logged
method 8: permission changes are logged
method 8: auth logs carry actor and context
